opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants: New Projects and Commissions

amount.raw: The maximum grant available in this category is £20,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-profit organisations (UK and international). For exhibitions, exhibition catalogues and sculpture commissions that aim to encourage new thinking about sculpture or sculpture history, or contribute to public awareness and appreciation of sculpture.
opportunities.summary: Funding for exhibitions, exhibition catalogues and sculpture commissions. Applications considered four times per year; Autumn round currently open (closes 1 September 2026).

opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants: Acquisitions and Collections

amount.raw: The maximum grant available in this category is £20,000.

opportunities.summary: To acquire new sculptural works for collections, or to conserve sculpture in existing collections. Also considers grants for cataloguing and display costs. Applications considered four times per year; Autumn round currently open.

opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants: Conferences, Lectures and Publications

amount.raw: The maximum grant awarded in this category is £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-profit organisations (UK and international). Exhibition catalogues are only eligible under the New Projects and Commissions category.
opportunities.summary: To publish a new book or journal, or to stage a conference or other event related to sculpture. Applications considered four times per year; Autumn round currently open.

opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants: Long-Term Research grants

amount.raw: The maximum grant available in this category is £20,000.

opportunities.summary: To support extended research projects requiring funding for more than one year, e.g. a permanent collection catalogue. Applications considered four times per year; Autumn round currently open.

opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants: Research and Travel grants

amount.raw: The maximum grant available in this category is £2,500.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals: sculpture historians, academics and conservators who are researching and publishing on sculpture conservation, production, history and/or interpretation. Cannot be used to inform or develop an artist's own work or professional practice.
opportunities.summary: To support research costs, travel, photography and archival access for sculpture historians, academics and conservators. Applications considered four times per year; Autumn round currently open.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, Rest of world up to £1,000, plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Visiting Research Fellowships); researchers whose interests lie in Henry Moore specifically (Studios & Gardens); artists developing their practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships); established scholars for six-week Senior Fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling researchers to spend a month using facilities at the Henry Moore Institute in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses. Applications currently closed for 2026/27; next round opens in spring 2027.
